cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can finally use what I taught you about parties. Help me surprise Denise on Friday; you choose the decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time you let me choose, then replaced everything with silver balloons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You were still learning restraint. This time I'll wash glasses and leave your choices alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Even if I use the enormous paper sun you made me take down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, even that sun. You've finally learned to insist on your own idea. Keep Denise out until Friday; I'll help you hang it.

reason: Remove the vague early-influence cover story; make accepting B rejected decoration the evidence of pupil progress that secures its secret cooperation.
